recordConstruction: Each raw historical name in the immutable Chapter XIV seed becomes one source record at read time. Candidate overlays add evidence only; they never replace source transliterations.
rawSourceCategoryPolicy: Root-source category is UNKNOWN unless the controlling Chapter XIV witness itself explicitly establishes it. Candidate overlays cannot populate rawSourceCategory.
